name: group-expenses
description: A shared expense page for a trip or a house, with balances and who pays whom.

interface.longDescription:
Track shared money for a trip, a shared flat or a group event: one page where everyone adds what they paid and sees who owes whom. Zovo Group Expenses publishes the page from the chat and gives you two links: a public link for the group and a private organizer link for you.

On the page, anyone with the link adds an expense on a phone, with no account and no app: who paid, how much, what for, and how to split it. Split equally between the people who shared it, by set amounts per person, or by shares (for example 2 for a couple and 1 for a single). The page shows each person's balance and a short list of payments that settles everyone up. When someone pays a friend back, they record the payment and the balances update.

The arithmetic uses whole cents (or yen, or fils) with a stated rule: each person gets the rounded-down share, and any leftover cents go one each to the people whose share lost the most in the rounding (ties, as in an equal split, go to the person listed first). The settle-up list has at most one fewer payment than people, and it is checked to bring each balance to zero. Each currency uses its own decimals, so JPY has none and KWD has three.

Ask ChatGPT for the balances at any time with the organizer link. You can also add expenses from the chat, add a member, delete an expense by its number, or close the page when the trip is over. The organizer page lists all expenses and has a CSV download.

Limitations: one currency per ledger with no exchange rates; names only, no accounts or reminders; anyone with the public link can add expenses; pages end 120 days after they are made.
defaultPrompt: Make a shared expense page for our Lisbon trip in EUR for Ana, Ben, Chi and Dev
Shared flat ledger in GBP for Sam, Priya and Tom. Sam paid 96.30 for groceries
Expense page in JPY for Ken, Yui and Aoi. Yui paid 10,000 yen for dinner for all three

positive.description: Trip ledger with first expenses and settle-up
positive.prompt: Make a shared expense page for our Lisbon trip in EUR for Ana, Ben, Chi and Dev. Ana paid 240 for the apartment, Ben 86.50 for dinner, Chi 36 for a taxi shared with Ana only
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_expense_ledger with currency EUR, the four members and three expenses (the taxi split between Ana and Chi). The reply gives the public link to share and the private organizer link to keep. Total 362.50 EUR. Balances: Ana +140.37, Ben +4.87, Chi -63.62, Dev -81.62. Settle up: Dev pays Ana 81.62, Chi pays Ana 58.75, Chi pays Ben 4.87, and every balance is then 0.

positive.description: House ledger, then read the results
positive.prompt: Create a shared flat ledger in GBP for Sam, Priya and Tom. Sam paid 96.30 for groceries for everyone, Tom paid 45 for cleaning for Priya and Tom. Then show me who owes whom
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_expense_ledger, then show_expense_ledger_results with the organizer link. Balances: Sam +64.20, Priya -54.60, Tom -9.60. Settle up: Priya pays Sam 54.60 GBP and Tom pays Sam 9.60 GBP.

positive.description: Yen ledger, then add an expense from the chat
positive.prompt: Make a JPY expense page for our Kyoto weekend for Ken, Yui and Aoi. Then add that Yui paid 10,000 yen for dinner for all three
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_expense_ledger with currency JPY, then add_ledger_expenses with the organizer link. Yen has no decimals, so 10,000 split three ways is Ken 3,334, Yui 3,333 and Aoi 3,333 (the leftover yen goes to the person listed first).

positive.description: Close a ledger when the trip ends
positive.prompt: Make a USD expense page for Mia and Leo's road trip. Leo paid 120.40 for gas. Then close the page so nobody can add more
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_expense_ledger, then update_expense_ledger with status closed. The ledger is closed and the balances stay visible: Mia pays Leo 60.20 USD.

positive.description: Three-decimal currency and a share split
positive.prompt: Expense page in KWD for Omar, Lina and Sara. Omar paid 10.000 for dinner for all. Lina paid 4.500 for dessert split by shares: Omar 2, Lina 1, Sara 1
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_expense_ledger with currency KWD (3 decimals) and two expenses, the second with split shares. Omar's share is 5.584. Balances: Omar +4.416, Lina +0.042, Sara -4.458. Settle up: Sara pays Omar 4.416 KWD and Sara pays Lina 0.042 KWD.

negative.description: A one-off bill split nobody else needs to open. Expected: the tool is not called; ChatGPT does the arithmetic in the chat.
negative.prompt: Split a 84 dollar dinner bill three ways with a 20% tip

negative.description: Moving real money is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains it cannot send payments.
negative.prompt: Send Ben the 42 euros I owe him through my bank

negative.description: Currency conversion is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called or the assistant says a ledger uses one currency with no exchange rates.
negative.prompt: Convert 500 Thai baht to euros at today's rate

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: a shared expense page with equal, exact and share splits, balances, a settle-up list, payments, edit links, an organizer page and CSV export.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wspólne koszty wyjazdu i domu
pl-PL.description: Utwórz jedną wspólną stronę wydatków na wyjazd, wspólne mieszkanie lub wydarzenie. Każdy z linkiem dodaje, ile zapłacił i jak podzielić koszt: po równo, dokładnymi kwotami lub według udziałów. Strona pokazuje saldo każdej osoby i krótką listę przelewów, które wyrównują rachunki. Organizator dostaje prywatny link z listą wydatków i plikiem CSV. Ograniczenia: jedna waluta na stronę, bez kursów wymiany; tylko imiona, bez kont i przypomnień; strona wygasa po 120 dniach.

de-DE.subtitle: Gemeinsame Kosten teilen
de-DE.description: Erstellen Sie eine gemeinsame Ausgabenseite für eine Reise, eine WG oder ein Gruppenevent. Alle mit dem Link tragen ein, was sie bezahlt haben, und wie es geteilt wird: gleichmäßig, mit genauen Beträgen oder nach Anteilen. Die Seite zeigt den Saldo jeder Person und eine kurze Liste von Zahlungen, die alles ausgleicht. Der Organisator erhält einen privaten Link mit allen Ausgaben und CSV-Export. Einschränkungen: eine Währung pro Seite, keine Wechselkurse; nur Namen, keine Konten oder Erinnerungen; die Seite endet nach 120 Tagen.

es-ES.subtitle: Gastos compartidos del grupo
es-ES.description: Crea una página de gastos compartidos para un viaje, un piso compartido o un evento. Cualquiera con el enlace añade lo que pagó y cómo se reparte: a partes iguales, con importes exactos o por partes. La página muestra el saldo de cada persona y una lista corta de pagos para quedar en paz. El organizador recibe un enlace privado con todos los gastos y una descarga CSV. Limitaciones: una moneda por página, sin tipos de cambio; solo nombres, sin cuentas ni recordatorios; la página termina a los 120 días.

fr-FR.subtitle: Dépenses de groupe partagées
fr-FR.description: Créez une page de dépenses partagée pour un voyage, une colocation ou un événement. Toute personne ayant le lien ajoute ce qu'elle a payé et comment le partager : à parts égales, par montants exacts ou par parts. La page montre le solde de chacun et une courte liste de remboursements qui équilibre tout. L'organisateur reçoit un lien privé avec toutes les dépenses et un export CSV. Limites : une devise par page, sans taux de change ; des prénoms seulement, sans compte ni rappel ; la page prend fin après 120 jours.

ja-JP.subtitle: 旅行やシェアハウスの割り勘
ja-JP.description: 旅行、シェアハウス、グループのイベント用に、共有の支出ページを作成します。リンクを知っている人は誰でも、支払った金額と分け方（均等、金額指定、比率）を入力できます。ページには各自の残高と、全員の精算が終わる短い送金リストが表示されます。主催者には、すべての支出とCSVダウンロードがある非公開リンクが届きます。制限事項：1ページにつき1通貨で為替換算はありません。名前のみでアカウントやリマインダーはありません。ページは120日後に終了します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Despesas compartilhadas
pt-BR.description: Crie uma página de despesas compartilhadas para uma viagem, uma casa dividida ou um evento. Quem tem o link adiciona quanto pagou e como dividir: em partes iguais, por valores exatos ou por cotas. A página mostra o saldo de cada pessoa e uma lista curta de pagamentos que acerta as contas. O organizador recebe um link privado com todas as despesas e download em CSV. Limitações: uma moeda por página, sem câmbio; apenas nomes, sem contas ou lembretes; a página termina após 120 dias.
